title: Billy Eckstine's band at the Regal Theater
summary: He recalls Eckstine's band with Miles Davis and Doug Mettome, plus altoist Flap Dungee, in its last week.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: That doesn’t sound logical to me.
Well he became his accompanist later on.
Oh yeah, but not with the big band, no.
John Malachi, I think, was the pianist with the big band.

It’s funny, he had at the Regal, he had an alto player that played like in Bird’s old Kansas City swingin’ style. His name was Flap - John Dungee - and he used to wear his saxophone strap over his shoulder instead of around his neck, and he sort of played like that. And he was just swinging and singin’ the band.
Yeah, he was great. I think Jug was still on the band, Gene Ammons, but Flap was the man for me.
